subject: general
question: Which Constitutional Amendment added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular' and 'Integrity' to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**42nd Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **42nd Amendment** to the Indian Constitution was enacted in the year **1976**, during the Emergency period.
 
• This amendment is also known as the **Mini-Constitution** due to the extensive changes it brought to the Constitution.
 
• The words **“Socialist,” “Secular,”** and **“Integrity”** were added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
 
• These additions aimed to reflect the vision of a society based on **social justice, secularism, and national unity and integrity.**
 
• The word **“Socialist”** indicates the commitment to achieving economic equality and social justice.
 
• The term **“Secular”** emphasizes that the state does not favor any religion and treats all religions equally.
 
• The inclusion of **“Integrity”** underlines the importance of maintaining the unity and integrity of the nation.
 
• This amendment also brought significant changes to the functioning of the Parliament, Judiciary, and Executive, enhancing the power of the Central Government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **38th Amendment**__

 __
 
• The **38th Amendment** was passed in **1975** during the Emergency period.
 
• It made the declaration of Emergency by the President **non-justiciable**, meaning the courts could not question its validity.
 
• It also gave the President additional powers to declare different types of emergencies.
 
 
 
• **52nd Amendment**__
 __
 
• The **52nd Amendment**, enacted in **1985**, introduced the **Anti-Defection Law**.
 
• It added the **Tenth Schedule** to the Constitution to curb political defection by legislators.
 
• This amendment aimed to ensure political stability by preventing elected members from changing parties for personal gains.
 
 
 
• **44th Amendment**__
 
 
• The **44th Amendment**, passed in **1978**, aimed at undoing some changes made by the 42nd Amendment.
 
• It restored the power of judicial review to the courts and ensured the protection of **Fundamental Rights**.
 
• It also made changes to the provisions related to the declaration of Emergency, requiring stricter conditions for its proclamation.
